issues.code_location: CancunGasCalculator.java - class scope, no blob fee method
issues.description: The provided file contains no implementation of blob base-fee pricing. EIP-4844 requires fake_exponential and get_base_fee_per_blob_gas using MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS=1 and BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION=3338477. Only blobGasCost(count)=per-blob*count is present.
issues.potential_impact: If not implemented elsewhere, nodes would mis-price blob gas, under/over charge blob_fee, cause incorrect balance deduction/burn and consensus split with correctly pricing clients.
issues.suggestion: Verify blob-gas price calculation with fake_exponential(factor, numerator, denominator) exists in fee-market/excess-blob-gas module and returns MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS * e**(excess_blob_gas / BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION). Do not implement only per-blob cost here.

issues.code_location: CancunGasCalculator.java - class scope, no excess_blob_gas method
issues.description: No calc_excess_blob_gas logic found. Spec requires parent-based update with TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK=393216. File only defines BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOB=1<<17 and blobGasCost().
issues.potential_impact: If missing globally, excess_blob_gas header field cannot be validated/updated, breaking header extension validation and fee adjustment, leading to consensus failure and uncontrolled blob growth.
issues.suggestion: Ensure separate header-validation module implements calc_excess_blob_gas and checks block.header.excess_blob_gas == calc_excess_blob_gas(parent) with genesis zero case.

issues.code_location: CancunGasCalculator.java - blobGasCost() method, no block-limit check
issues.description: File implements unbounded multiplication getBlobGasPerBlob()*blobCount with no enforcement of MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK=786432, TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK=393216, blob_gas_used header match, or per-transaction accounting via get_total_blob_gas.
issues.potential_impact: If no other module enforces assert blob_gas_used <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK and header match, blocks with >6 blobs could be accepted, exceeding 0.75 MB sustained load design and causing consensus split and DoS/bandwidth strain.
issues.suggestion: Verify block validation and check_transaction enforce blob_gas_available = MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK - blob_gas_used, reject overflow, and assert block.header.blob_gas_used == blob_gas_used.

issues.code_location: CancunGasCalculator.java - class scope, no precompile or versioned-hash validation
issues.description: No BLOBHASH opcode logic, no VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01) check, no kzg_to_versioned_hash match, no verify_kzg_proof / verify_blob_kzg_proof_batch, and no POINT_EVALUATION_PRECOMPILE_ADDRESS (0x0A) with POINT_EVALUATION_PRECOMPILE_GAS=50000 and canonical field-element (<BLS_MODULUS) checks. Constructor only references KZG_POINT_EVAL address byte for maxPrecompile.
issues.potential_impact: If absent elsewhere, invalid KZG commitments, non-canonical z/y, wrong versioned hashes, or empty blob_versioned_hashes could be accepted, breaking data-availability guarantees and allowing invalid blob transactions or incorrect fraud/ZK proofs.
issues.suggestion: Verify separate precompile module implements length==192 assert, commitment->versioned_hash match, verify_kzg_proof, non-canonical rejection, return FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB and BLS_MODULUS, plus transaction validation for len>0 and h[0]==VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG and max_fee_per_blob_gas >= base fee.

summary: CancunGasCalculator correctly implements the narrow gas portion GAS_PER_BLOB=2**17 (131072) and blobGasCost=per-blob*count matching get_total_blob_gas. All other consensus-critical EIP-4844 logic (fake_exponential pricing, excess_blob_gas update, block limits, KZG/versioned-hash validation, point-evaluation precompile) is absent from this file and must be verified in other Besu modules for full compliance.
